summary: 13 FSPC file types; no fontspace type in the baseline.
correction: Keep the 13 existing contracts. Propose fontspace as a justified, unimplemented addition.

summary: Header 20 bytes; instance row 112 bytes; material slot 24 bytes.
correction: Use actual serialized fields, not superseded prose sizes. Freeze v1 fixtures before new layouts.

summary: Reference record combines type/mode/path/blob with FNV-1a 64 content hash.
correction: Specify independent logical identity, immutable revision, output token, SHA-256 and locator.

summary: External-reference load returns file bytes without comparing recorded content hash.
correction: Verify external and embedded payload digests and expected type/revision under the same contract.

summary: SpacePack embeds the current file REFS; it does not recurse into loaded payload dependencies.
correction: Traverse and pin the complete dependency closure, with full missing/cycle chains and budgets.

summary: Parse checks bounds/type/mandatory presence, records checksum failures, and returns true.
correction: Separate structural inspection from strict load; reject bad required sections before typed access.

summary: Find returns the first matching tag; Parse has no duplicate-singleton or overlap rejection.
correction: Define duplicate/overlap/alignment policy, version/feature validation and allocation/work limits.

summary: Writer uses table insertion order, hash-sorted blobs, and raw serialized row bytes.
correction: Define canonical semantic ordering and ABI-independent encoding; do not promise arbitrary byte identity.

summary: Extraction interpolates a directory into a shell mkdir and truncates destination files.
correction: Use filesystem APIs, contained paths, explicit no-overwrite policy, staging and atomic publication.

summary: Quoted output paths may permit command injection; no exploit was executed.
correction: Treat the shell boundary as a security review blocker, not an already-demonstrated exploit.

summary: Geometry export serializes resident VertexRecord bytes and a fixed cluster prefix.
correction: Preserve legacy export/readers; define durable authored CAD schemas separate from GPU representations.

summary: CAD has recipe operations and figure IDs, but edge/face inputs include array indices.
correction: Adapt the document model; define durable output/topology tokens and explicit split/merge rebinding.

summary: Recipe regeneration iterates at most four rounds rather than dependency-order evaluation.
correction: Specify typed DAG validation and deterministic ordering; retain last-valid output and diagnostics.

summary: Undo/redo stores and swaps SceneDocument snapshots.
correction: Keep editor navigation separate from persistent authoring dependencies and revision ancestry.

summary: An editable .arc construction-journal save/open path already exists.
correction: Preserve .arc as legacy input. Import supported construction into the new schema without discarding it.

summary: Open replays into a candidate host; constraints, dimensions and named planes also live on ConsoleHost.
correction: Candidate replay is not a security sandbox. Map all authored state, not SceneDocument alone.

summary: Command dispatch invokes recipe regeneration and snapshot undo settlement.
correction: Reconnect real command consumers; do not implement a parallel CAD authoring model.

summary: State domains and several authoring editors are explicitly deferred in the old document.
correction: Preserve that status; container vocabulary is not complete editable-domain persistence.

summary: The historical gate compiles CPU tools with Vulkan headers and suppresses some warnings.
correction: Do not run the old gate as if it validates a proposed revision; define focused new fixtures and platform checks.

summary: Two historical checks explicitly skip GPU image-comparison halves.
correction: Historical results are not current runs or Windows/GPU validation.

summary: CLI parses embed-font policy; that bit alone does not implement a native font document.
correction: Propose fontspace semantics and trace packaging consumers before assigning a type tag.

summary: Pack/explode wrappers build/reuse the shared tool, with POSIX paths and output conventions.
correction: Reuse the codec boundary, replace unsafe platform assumptions, and verify supported Windows tooling.

summary: A runtime sky-probe reader uses SpaceReader and checks staged cache compatibility.
correction: Keep cache compatibility checks explicit; never mistake evaluated cache persistence for authored geometry.

summary: Complete project-open consumer coverage is not established by parsing CLI options alone.
correction: Finish launch/export consumer mapping in phase 1 before claiming an end-to-end migration.

summary: Strict acyclic typed dependencies, immutable revisions, stable outputs and safe offline closure.
correction: The existing resolver/pack API is a reuse candidate, not evidence that these new guarantees are implemented.

summary: Fontspace includes licensing, pinned fallback, variable-axis metadata and derived atlas provenance.
correction: Review existing FontCodec/TypefaceRegistry/TOML catalogue in the current checkout; add no duplicate runtime path.
